name: University College London
summary: About 440 undergraduate courses in Bloomsbury, central London, from Medicine to Arts and Sciences (BASc); offers use IB points and HL totals.

ib.text: Offers run from 34 points (16 at HL) to 40 (20 at HL), no HL below 5. English A: 5 for English Levels 1–2, 6 for Level 3, HL 6 or SL 7 for Level 4, HL 7 for Level 5.

programmes.name: Arts and Sciences (Societies) BASc
programmes.about: An interdisciplinary degree taught only at UCL. A shared Core teaches you to work across arts, social science and science, then you choose specialist modules from across the university, study a modern language throughout and can take internships. Societies is one of three pathways.
programmes.ib: 39 points with 19 in three HL subjects, including a Social Science, and no HL below 5.
programmes.selectionNote: No subject test or questionnaire for 2027 entry. The personal statement need not be written for this course; show skills and interests that fit the pathway.

flagshipSource.title: Arts and Sciences BASc: an interdisciplinary degree across arts, social sciences and sciences

programmes.name: Architecture BSc
programmes.about: Architecture learned in a studio: drawing, model-making and portfolio work from day one. From year two you join a Bartlett Design Unit, a small studio led by practising architects, with themes from craft and film to philosophy and science, plus a first-year international field trip.
programmes.ib: 36 points with 17 in three HL subjects and no HL below 5. No subject is required, but a creative portfolio is.
programmes.selectionNote: After you apply, upload a 10-page portfolio within two weeks; shortlisted applicants have an online interview, usually mid-November to late April.

flagshipSource.title: Architecture BSc: studio teaching and Bartlett Design Units led by practising architects

programmes.name: Economics BSc (Econ)
programmes.about: Economic theory with the maths and statistics to use it, applied to questions such as climate change, inequality and inflation. Students can present research at the annual Explore Econ conference and hear visiting economists at the Stone Centre and finance lectures.
programmes.ib: 39 points with 19 in three HL subjects, including a 7 in HL Maths (AA or AI), and no HL below 5.
programmes.selectionNote: The TMUA is required alongside the UCAS application; no interview is listed for 2027. Resits are not accepted.

flagshipSource.title: Economics BSc (Econ): a department with a student research conference and named lecture series

faculties.name: Faculty of Arts and Humanities
faculties.line: English: no test or interview for 2027. European and International Social and Political Studies: Thinking Skills Test. Fine Art: portfolio.

faculties.name: The Bartlett Faculty of the Built Environment
faculties.line: Architecture: a 10-page digital portfolio, then an online interview; 36 IB points and no set subjects.

faculties.name: Faculty of Brain Sciences
faculties.line: Psychology BSc: 39 points with 7 and 6 in two HL from Biology, Chemistry, Maths, Physics or Psychology. No test is listed for 2027.

faculties.name: Faculty of Education and Society (IOE)
faculties.line: Sociology and Social Sciences need no test in 2027; Media BA asks for an online portfolio of up to six items.

faculties.name: Faculty of Engineering Sciences
faculties.line: Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering sit the TARA, Electronic and Electrical Engineering the ESAT, from 2027 entry.

faculties.name: Faculty of Laws
faculties.line: Every applicant sits the LNAT by 31 December 2026; the essay is marked by an admissions tutor and carries considerable weight.

faculties.name: Faculty of Life Sciences
faculties.line: Biological Sciences BSc: 38 points with HL Biology 6 plus Chemistry, Maths or Physics, and no HL below 5.

faculties.name: Faculty of Mathematical and Physical Sciences
faculties.line: Mathematics is highly competitive, with a typical A-level offer of A*A*A; check each degree for its HL Maths grade.

faculties.name: Faculty of Medical Sciences
faculties.line: MBBS closes 15 October: UCAT ranks applicants for interviews from December, none is offered a place without one; 24 overseas places.

faculties.name: Faculty of Social and Historical Sciences
faculties.line: Economics sits the TMUA and needs HL Maths 7; Anthropology, Geography, History and the other degrees list no extra test for 2027.

notes: The international fee for Anthropology BSc is £40,800 a year in 2027/28.
For 2027 Economics needs the TMUA, Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering the TARA, Electronic Engineering the ESAT, Law the LNAT and Medicine the UCAT.
If you take four HL subjects UCL counts your best three, and it adds up to three ToK and Extended Essay bonus points to your total.
